findings: Explicit re-run of an Issue whose bound Intent is no longer the active Intent stops as reconcile-required ('intake binding is bound') instead of resuming; no duplicate is created, but the operator needs a documented resume path.

Label polling never skips an Issue that stops on uncertainty (run 1): the loop stays on the lowest ambiguous Issue until a human resolves it. Fail-closed by design; worth documenting for /loop operators.

GitHub search indexes a new Issue after a few seconds (search-probe: found on the second poll, ~7s). A lost create response reconciled immediately can stop as pending-receipt-unresolved; a later retry binds the same Issue, never a duplicate.
